steps.name: some gift (1)
steps.objective: After talking to [Narin] in “Gerda,” defeat [Argos] in “Icicle Prison” to obtain <Ice Necklace>. Then report to [Narin] in 「Gerda」.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: This is really troubling. What should I do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narin, do you have any concerns? With my sigh, all the ice around me is melting.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Are you here?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Oh, if I do this, Gerda will become anxious too, so I will come to my senses.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Narinnarinnaririn!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narin, what are those spell-like words? No, what is it? uh?
(As Narin finishes the strange spell and stretches, a cool and refreshing breeze blows across Gerda's sky.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: A long time ago, when I first met Io, this is the spell I told her to cheer me up.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: At first, I wondered if there was such a thing as something like this, but as I continued to do it, the effects came naturally.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Weapon attribute power, penetration power, and movement speed do not increase.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What is that... .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: This is just something I said. Hehehe. Narin, I have a favor to ask you. Is it okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First, please tell me what it is.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I am telling you this because I believe it is an opportune time without Io.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io's father, Uncle Inachus, and Uncle Argos were best friends. So, if there was anything going on in the village, he always consulted us.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: In particular, Mr. Argos was so sincere towards Gerda that he always asked her to call him when doing hard work.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: So, Uncle Inacos used his skills to make ice sculptures and ornaments and gave them to Uncle Argos.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: The ring I gave to Aunt Melia as a proposal was also handmade.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: From what I remember, they were also making something for Io until not long before that happened.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: So I want to find it. %s If the memory of that remains behind the ‘behind’ where your steps reach… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Narin cares about Io a lot.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hehehe, this is the kid who taught me nonsense spells like Narin Narin Naririn. Since I am asking you a favor, I will definitely thank you.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Coupon for Adventurer trusted by the spirits! It will be certain as it is also certified by the Goddess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Coupon! The effect of the coupon was definitely good. Hmm, then I'll go to the prison where Argos was.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I want to go with you, but it's an area I, as a spirit, can't reach... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay, Narin. I'll be back.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Please be careful.

steps.name: some gift (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Echo] in 「Fountain of Echoes」 and obtain <Ice Mirror>. Then report to [Narin] in 「Gerda」.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Welcome, %s. Fortunately, Io hasn't arrived yet... . What you hold in your hand... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This was found in the room where Argos was.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: A necklace made of pure ice… .
(Narin takes the necklace from %s and examines it.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: This is made with the best ice Deborah had in her possession. However, it seems to be melting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Melting?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I'll try freezing it again.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Oh my... . I guess my powers aren't working... .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Could it be that Echo… .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: That evil thing must have done something to this necklace.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: In that case, we will have to solve it with the power of Echo.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Yes, I wonder if there are any items in the spring that still have Echo's power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go and look for it. Please wait. I will come quickly before Io comes.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Thank you, %s. Oh, you’re already leaving… . I heard he’s a really driven person.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Phew, I wanted to finish it before Io came... .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Seeing the snow-covered clouds coming with the wind, it looks like the work is done... .

steps.name: some gift (3)
steps.objective: Talk to [Narin] in “Gerda” and visit [Io] to complete the quest.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Adventurer… , are you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know if it's Echo's, but I brought it because there was a suspicious item. Uh, io… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I heard the story. Going to an ominous place again at Narin's request... .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Wasn’t it your request first?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Oh, that's right. Sorry. Because these are tired people and spirits.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: As an example, I decided to give you a coupon of trust given by the spirits.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: A coupon given by a spirit if you do a good deed... . Still, since it was given by the Spirit King, it would be effective, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it was better than I expected.
(Narin unfolds the scroll and places the ice necklace and ice mirror together.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I guess you learned how to use the scroll during this time?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: That's it. Somehow, I find myself continuing to apply it.
(As Narin extends her hand, the ice mirror splits and splits into several pieces.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: This ice mirror has no unclean energy at all. If this happens, will this necklace not melt?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Yes, you can use these ice cubes to freeze the necklace.
(Narin gathers Io's hands together and places the necklace and ice cubes inside them.)
(As Narin nods, Io also nods. After a while, a small snowstorm appears around Io and flows into her hand.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I think it’s done… .
(Io shakes the necklace slightly in her hand. It shines with a more pure and clean feeling than when she first saw it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's beautiful... .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: It's made from the cleanest ice in the Deborah Snowfield.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: … That's enough. So what's written here? It's so small you can't see it well.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Is it possible for one’s eyesight to be good if one stays alone and studies? Just wait a moment.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin, what's wrong? What does it say, and does it look like that?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Do you mind if I read it?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'm fine. So don't worry... .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: “To my daughter Ionis, who resembles Ionia in the North Sea… .」

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Father… ?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Only a spirit would have been able to possess this level of pure determination. Because at that time, I was unable to do anything... .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: He probably told you your story while helping Echo. But Echo... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey… .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: %s, I would like you to leave for a moment. After a while, Io will call you, so come to Io's mansion.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, I’ll see you later… .
(Io is unable to say anything and is lowering her head. Narin approaches Io and gently hugs her.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Seeing you like this, I find myself speechless. But there is something I can do for you.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Even though I can't embrace you with warmth like a human, I'm glad I can still be there for you... .

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hey… . Now, just for this moment, let go.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: … Narin, thank you… .
(Water drops fall one by one from Gerda's sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rain… ?
(Slow drops of rain fall from the clouds that brought the blizzard. Perhaps because of the gray clouds, Gerda's once white appearance turns grey.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel lonely... . It feels like the sky is crying.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Will Io be okay? Oh, hey… .
(%s can see Io beckoning from a distance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's go first.
(As soon as Io sees %s, she looks sorry.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Aren’t they telling me to go, aren’t they telling me to come? I'm really sorry for being so moody.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm okay, is Io okay?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'm fine. Sometimes it won't be okay, but it will always be okay. See, it's still okay now.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hey, your eyes are swollen like snowballs. Thump thump.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin, are you going to freeze me then?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Did you think I would stay still? I also picked up some ice from somewhere... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Phew… . Okay, okay. Let's stop. anyhow… . %s! thank you.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: But because of me and Narin, we couldn’t even go to the goddess.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. I would say Iris is ok too.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: … I know. It's just a momentary moment, but I think you said, Io, I'm fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: That's right. From what I hear of the goddess, she is older than %s.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hey, are you showing off that you’re older?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Don't mind what I said, I hope to see you in Gerda often. If anything is difficult, talk about it right away.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I told Gallet about it. Whenever you come to Gerda, feel free to use the folk tales. Because I will support you for the rest of your life.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … For life?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Yes, for life. I promise. why?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nothing. That's because you're so kind to me.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It’s bland… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. Then I'll go take a short break. See you later.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Okay, get some rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, but I feel like I missed something. What is it…?)
(Io and Narin wave to %s heading towards the snowfall.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I've heard the story roughly, but it's the stamp of the spirit that stamps coupons. Why did it start with Miss Medea's story and end up in your hands?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hmm… , I don’t know about that either. However, you can be suspicious... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Phew, I guess I should. Because of Echo work, I haven't been able to pay much attention. I have to move quickly starting tomorrow.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: But Narin.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Why are you doing that?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Did you give %s a stamped coupon?
